scope: OFFLINE DESCRIPTIVE ONLY; not a strategy, backtest, observer or predictive validation
freeze: Commit before computing historical event summaries. Already observed November examples are contaminated diagnostics, not parameter-selection or validation data.

series.ADX: unchanged audited DMI14, ADX RMA14; plus/minus DI recorded; not direction
series.PECECILLOS: unchanged public BITMAN PROXY; red=EMA15(tendencia), not EMA(pececillos); tendencia, sharks and red logged separately
series.BBWP_7_100: unchanged audited literal supplied The_Caretaker source: SMA(close,7), population stdev, BBW=2*stdev/SMA; prior100 width rank, rightmost-index/ties and warmup as source
series.BBWP_13_252: same literal rank formula, basis13/lookback252; explicitly separate requested settings comparison, not replacement/correction of historical7/100 nor certified TradingOne settings
series.platform_parity: NOT ESTABLISHED without same-feed closed-bar export, indicator identity/settings/source and initialization prefix; owner-reported one rounded Spot pececillos point is partial visual evidence only

causal_events.prealert: same nonzero sign of d[t-1] and d[t], abs(d[t])<abs(d[t-1]); first bar of each uninterrupted deceleration run only. Expected indicator slope=-sign(d[t]). No magnitude threshold, Q75, zero crossing or price/context gate.
causal_events.confirmation: strict1+1 reversal: d[t-1]*d[t]<0, first available at close[t]. Also count confirmations without any prior prealert.
causal_events.prealert_resolution: within next2 closed hours: first strict reversal confirms; flat slope invalidates; renewed same-side acceleration/equal magnitude invalidates; otherwise expire at end of2h. End-of-file before full resolution is censored. No resurrection or repeated alert during uninterrupted deceleration.
causal_events.confirmation_instability: first zero slope or reverse slope in next2 closed hours is recorded as locally unstable, not a price/trade invalidation. End-of-file is censored.
causal_events.gap: gap/nonfinite resets all pending; first3 consecutive finite closes required again
causal_events.window_rationale: 2h fixed inherited temporal proximity from PR55; not selected on this example. A diagnostic definition of false prealert, not universal false-signal rate. No other expiry optimization.
causal_events.direction: AO/pececillos anticipated slope provides descriptive UP/DOWN hypothesis. ADX/BBWP only describe rising/falling strength/volatility; price distances for BOTH UP and DOWN are retained, never infer market side from these alone.

price_timing.known_anchor: at prealert freeze lowest low for UP / highest high for DOWN since beginning of current uninterrupted indicator-slope leg, including prealert bar. Leg starts at preceding bar of first same-sign slope. This is an already known reference, NOT a true future swing vertex or an executable entry.
price_timing.consumed: signed close-to-frozen-known-anchor percent at prealert and confirmation; close drift prealert->confirmation; delay hours; next-open price references after each, not guaranteed fills
price_timing.remaining: descriptive favorable/adverse excursion from each close to common endpoint prealert+4h. Exclude signal's own bar. Same endpoint for fair timing comparison; end-of-file incomplete outcomes missing, never zero.
price_timing.share: consumed distance divided by maximum anchor-to-favorable-extreme up to common4h endpoint. Explicit ex-post descriptive denominator, never detector input; negative values retained, no clipping or best-vertex selection.
price_timing.false_prealerts: publish all resolutions: confirmed, reacceleration, flat, expiry, bad data and censored. These measure indicator-turn reliability ONLY, not profitable entries.
price_timing.management: NONE: no trades, stops, targets, costs, sizing or equity results; PR55 results unchanged

outputs: all hourly values/differences; prealert lifecycle; all confirmation episodes; false prealerts; counts/delays/price-distance distributions; separate BBWP settings comparison; November availability table; tests/hashes/source audit
restrictions: No indicator changes, no tuning, no new combinations, no production/Guardian/V8/MLRSI/Railway/Bitunix/Telegram mutation, no orders, no infrastructure, merge or deploy. SHADOW ONLY. TRADE AUTHORITY NONE.
